logline: Emerging from the smoke of the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert, wins the loyalty of the royal guards, and is proclaimed the rightful Duke of Ashburn by his weeping mother.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 41 where Alexander's forces breached the cathedral entrance; Alexander now steps through the ruins, halting the wedding and unmasking Rupert's illegitimate reign.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Overcome, Loving)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: Look at you... my beautiful boy.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Proud)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Ringing, Authoritative)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grim, Vengeful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Medium two-shot framed down the ruined nave between Alexander and his mother.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert cowering on the altar steps beside Catherine and her father, utterly defeated.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Tight close-up on Alexander, his hand resting on the hilt of his sabre as his eyes burn with fierce, cold retribution.
